name: Module Cleaner
description: Inventory addon residue, prepare safe cleanup plans, and coordinate backups, quarantine, and purge handoff.
notes: 0.1.0s-CX applies the global UI presentation sweep: standard content grids, mobile-card tables, component-backed cards, metric cards, and page-action back navigation.

0.1.0r-CX adds owned persistence for cleanup plans, backup sets, quarantine items, orphan candidates, dependency edges, and self-destruct checks; dry-runs now record dependency/orphan/self-destruct evidence, backups record restore-plan metadata, and quarantine copies module files/storage/packages into Cleaner-owned quarantine without deleting source data.
0.1.0q-CX adds a Gate 14 SampleDataProviderContract implementation for Cleaner cleanup-log demos and requires host 0.7.12y-CX.
0.1.0p-CX migrates settings secondary sidebars to the host x-secondary-sidebar-nav component and requires host 0.7.12w-CX.
0.1.0l replaces the remaining Cleaner @php(...) one-line Blade directive with block-form @php/@endphp and adds an architecture guard against the Blade compile hazard.
0.1.0k converges Cleaner admin spacing onto the host .stack utility, applies is-card-table wrappers across every mobile-card table, and pins to the 0.7.9j host utility batch.
0.1.0j batches Cleaner UI compliance: dashboard stat cards, compact registry rows, no duplicate Cleanup Plans link, and better settings spacing.
0.1.0i drops redundant Longlink-prefixed addon display naming and pins the package to the host stale-navigation cleanup baseline.
0.1.0h restores WorkSuite-parity P0 foundations: persisted Cleaner settings, per-module backup evidence sets, review-only orphan table detection, and backup-confirmed host purge handoff.
0.1.0g replaces the Cleaner console button strip with host responsive category links and mobile Categories Menu behaviour.
0.1.0f exposes Cleaner as a Platform Tools console with dashboard, registry, module details, dry-run plans, orphan tables, backups, quarantine, logs, and settings views.
0.1.0f keeps purge execution dry-run/host-primitive only while surfacing the full cleanup workflow structure for review and future gated execution.
0.1.0e renames package inventory SQL aliases away from MariaDB reserved words to prevent the admin dashboard 500 on MySQL/MariaDB hosts.
0.1.0d fixes the admin cleaner route shell to use the host app-shell component and shared token-backed UI primitives.
Populate release. This module inventories ownership snapshots and creates dry-run cleanup plans through the host AddonModuleRegistry only.
Owned data is restricted to module_cleaner_* tables and module-owned storage. Core settings, permissions, navigation rows, and provider registry definitions self-clean through host registries.
Destructive purge execution remains host-guarded: backup first, typed confirmation, inactive module, and RequireStepUpForSensitiveActions on the host purge primitive.
release_notes: 0.1.0r-CX persists Cleaner plan/backup/quarantine/orphan/dependency/self-destruct coordination records and adds restore-plan preparation.
0.1.0q-CX adds a Gate 14 SampleDataProviderContract implementation for Cleaner cleanup-log demos and requires host 0.7.12y-CX.
0.1.0p-CX migrates settings secondary sidebars to the host x-secondary-sidebar-nav component and requires host 0.7.12w-CX.
